introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Computer Science 2 (0595), ORDINARY LEVEL, June 2022. Duration: two hours.**

Answer any FIVE questions. All questions carry 20 marks each. For your guidance, the approximate mark for each part of a question is indicated in brackets. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Calculators or Phones are NOT allowed.
incertitudes: Question 3 : points imprimés par sous-partie : a = 4, b = 4, c = 2, d = 2, e = 4, f = 4 ; total 20.

3(a) à (c) : réponses ouvertes, plusieurs combinaisons valables ; l'énoncé liste six activités, quatre sont retenues dans le corrigé (les deux autres sont citées). Les noms de logiciels (Sage, QuickBooks, Microsoft Access, MySQL, Excel, Word) sont des exemples génériques courants.
Dans l'énoncé, « computerize each transaction » et « Give an example ... for each transaction » : 2 points pour (c), soit 0,5 point par exemple pour quatre transactions.

Sujet scanné de 4 pages (page de garde + 3 pages de questions) : 7 questions, « Answer any FIVE questions », 20 points chacune ; règle de choix codée `parmi 5 sur 7` (portée « PAPER 2 »), identique dans les 7 fichiers. Aucun corrigé officiel : corrigés rédigés, la page a un filigrane gcerevision.com ignoré.
Aucun programme C ou Pascal dans ce sujet : rien à compiler. Les conversions, additions et soustractions binaires, tables de vérité et le chemin critique ont été recalculés avec Python.

questions.enonce_markdown: (a) State four (4) transactions of the company. (4 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**Four transactions (4 marks, 1 mark each).** Any four of the following are accepted:

1. Collecting transport fares from clients at the cash office (selling tickets).
2. Online payment of fares by clients using electronic money transfer.
3. Travel reservations (booking of seats) made by clients.
4. Payment of the workers' salaries every two weeks (payroll).
5. Sending correspondence (letters, e-mails) to the partners of the company.
6. Scheduling the buses and their respective drivers every week.

The first four are used in the answers to (b) and (c).

questions.enonce_markdown: (b) State the type of application software that can be used to computerise each transaction. (4 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**Type of application software (4 marks, 1 mark per transaction)**

| Transaction | Type of application software |
|---|---|
| Collecting fares at the cash office | Accounting (financial) software, working with a database |
| Travel reservations | Database management software (booking database) |
| Paying the workers every two weeks | Spreadsheet software (or a payroll package) |
| Correspondence to partners | Word processing software |

For the other two transactions: online payment of fares - e-commerce / online payment application; scheduling of buses and drivers - spreadsheet or database software.

questions.enonce_markdown: (c) Give an example of an application software that can be used for each transaction. (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**Examples of application software (2 marks)**

| Transaction | Example of software |
|---|---|
| Collecting fares at the cash office | an accounting package such as Sage or QuickBooks |
| Travel reservations | a database program such as Microsoft Access or MySQL |
| Paying the workers | a spreadsheet program such as Microsoft Excel |
| Correspondence to partners | a word processor such as Microsoft Word |

Any correct example of the right type of software is accepted.

questions.enonce_markdown: (d) How can graphics software be used to improve upon the business? (2 marks)
(e) Explain two ways that the company can use the Internet to improve upon the business. (4 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**Two uses of the Internet (4 marks, 2 marks each)**

1. **A website with online booking and payment.** The company publishes its routes, timetables and fares on a website, and clients book seats and pay by mobile money or card at any time from anywhere. This attracts more clients, reduces queues at the cash office and increases sales.
2. **E-mail and social media.** The company sends correspondence to its partners by e-mail instantly and at very low cost, and advertises its services and special offers on social media, so that it reaches many more people and keeps contact with its clients.

Other accepted answers: tracking buses online, advertising for new workers, internet banking for transfers to partners.

questions.enonce_markdown:
(f) Briefly describe one method each that this company could apply to combat:

(i) unauthorised access to the computer systems.

(ii) unauthorised use of files. (4 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i) Unauthorised access to the computer systems (2 marks)**

Use **user names and strong passwords** (authentication): each worker has an account and must log in, so only authorised persons can enter the system. The company can add a **firewall** against outside intruders, biometric identification (fingerprint) or lock the computer room.

**(ii) Unauthorised use of files (2 marks)**

Set **access rights (permissions)** on files and folders, so that each user can only read, or read and modify, the files he or she needs, and **protect important files with a password or encrypt them**, so that a person who gets the file cannot read or use it.
